title: Slack Personal Activity Status Mix
dataSources: RescueTime activity (`rescuetime:activity`), Apple/Android screen-time exports (`screentime:usage`), GitHub events (`github:personal`), habit-tracker logs (`habit:entry`), calendar/todo exports.
app: Screen-time / RescueTime exports, GitHub personal activity, habit/journal trackers, and calendar feeds via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=slack:personal
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(activity_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the Slack personal activity feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `activity_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It lets you the overall mood of your Slack personal activity feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
